findings.quote:
1. **Read the block, not the last line.** `REGRESSION_TOOL` ·
   `REGRESSION_DATE` · `REGRESSION_BAND` · `REGRESSION_EXPECT` · one
   `REGRESSION_PIN` per leg · per leg one `REGRESSION_SWEEP` +
   `REGRESSION_TABLE` + `REGRESSION_CASE` · `REGRESSION_DEFECT` rows for
   differences · `REGRESSION_WORKDIR` · the closing `REGRESSION:
   PASS|FAIL|SETUP` line.
findings.skill_statement: Item 1 states the per-leg receipt grammar unconditionally — "one `REGRESSION_PIN` per leg · per leg one `REGRESSION_SWEEP` + `REGRESSION_TABLE` + `REGRESSION_CASE`" — and in the same bullet names SETUP as a possible closing verdict, but a SETUP block emits none of those three lines for the legs that could not materialize. First-hand from the C** bytes: tools/mutate-and-run.sh at C** has sha256 977de470… (2159 lines); copied to a scratch lane root and run as `--regression` (TMPDIR + --workdir under the seat scratch), FLEET_ROOT resolved to the empty scratch root and every leg hit the repo_identity_mismatch SETUP at :1263, which returns before the REGRESSION_PIN printf at :1302 — the block carried the four REGRESSION_* header lines, ten REGRESSION_CASE SETUP lines and `REGRESSION: SETUP (cases=10 passed=0 cannot-verify=10)`, and zero REGRESSION_PIN / REGRESSION_SWEEP / REGRESSION_TABLE lines. The same shape is in the lane's committed evidence: .ufo/evidence/round-18/coldread/traces/CR18/7.out.txt has three SETUP legs with no PIN and no SWEEP/TABLE anywhere in the block, while the pin-mismatch legs in the same block do print PIN lines — so PIN presence is stage-dependent even within one block. The FAIL stage has the same gap: the sweep-exit (:1331) and no-results-table (:1337) FAIL arms print a REGRESSION_CASE FAIL with no REGRESSION_TABLE. Item 4 legitimizes exactly these SETUP blocks, so a cold reader applying item 1 to one would report the absent lines as a defect.
